title: spec(approvals): the typed decision-output docblock and approvals docs say `type`/`multiple` only shape the widget — rewrite to the enforced rule (#28658 ruling A, text slice)
body:
domain:server#5 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQKwKFCp1m6Pb6Q8c1

Parent: #28658 · Ruling-ref: 6566731522 (batch #450 item 2 · letter A)

## What

Ruling A on #28658 makes the approvals door enforce a typed decision output's declared `type` and `multiple` at the decision. It splits the work into two PRs, and this text slice lands **first**:

- `packages/spec/src/automation/approval.zod.ts`: the `DecisionOutputDefSchema` docblock (≈L660 at `5780fa49d`: "`type` and `multiple` only shape the INPUT WIDGET, never the accepted value") and the `required` docblock (≈L697-700: "Unlike `type`/`multiple` — which only shape the input widget") are rewritten to say what ADR-0104's 2026-10-30 amendment already records. A picker output is judged by id (`user`, `department`, `team`) or by machine name (`position`). `multiple: true` takes a list without duplicates, and an absent or false `multiple` takes one value. A mismatch is refused with `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` naming `outputs.<key>`, before any write.
- `content/docs/automation/approvals.mdx` follows the same text.

## Out of scope

- No schema shape, key, or `.describe()` change unless a describe string states the same contradiction. If one does, rewrite only that sentence.
- The runtime enforcement is the `domain:server` half (#28658, seat 5, branch `claude/project-thread-rsqu0h`). Its PR waits for this one to merge.

## Declaration

`Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, as the ruling writes it. `Metadata-protocol: none`. Docs/docblock text only.
